slots.purpose: Human, aspirational moment for the target couple (30s, destination, luxury) that breaks up the practical content and shows guest list planning as a shared task.
slots.shot_brief: Real photograph (never AI) of a couple in their 30s planning their guest list together at home: relaxed, warm, natural light from a window, late afternoon. Laptop open with a spreadsheet out of focus or screen angled away (no legible third-party app, no logos, no readable names), coffee or a glass of wine, a notebook or printed list, a hint of travel (passport or a destination guidebook). Calm, elevated interior in neutral tones that fits a luxury brand. Two people, faces visible or three-quarter. Must have a signed model release or couple consent and a licence covering blog, web and social; licensed stock (Stocksy, Offset or Getty, purchased by a human) or a partner photographer shoot, added to the Drive library and library-index.csv before use.
